gui.watheextended.guidebook.role.desc.wa: A keen and skilled hunter, tasked with eliminating the crew of the Harpy Express. The Razor is capable of killing in plain sight, with two extremely lethal knife abilities within their arsenal.
gui.watheextended.guidebook.role.abiliti:
{icon:nemesis} §lShiv§r
Stand within one block of a player and press [F] to shiv them, automatically equipping your knife and stabbing them before they can react. Shivved opponents will begin to bleed out; the more times you shiv your target, the quicker they'll bleed.
(25s -> 13s -> 7s)

{icon:knife} §lKnife Throw§r
Left click while holding right click to throw your knife. This eliminates quickly and quietly.

{icon:athletic} §lAthletic§r
Has infinite stamina.

{icon:instinct} §lInstinct§r
See players and §4Killer Cohorts§r through walls.

gui.watheextended.guidebook.role.desc.wa: Master of minds and men, the Psychagogue possesses the ability to control others' impulses. Their task is to unite the Cohorts and bring an end to the Harpy Express, once and for all.
gui.watheextended.guidebook.role.abiliti:
{icon:psychagogue} §lPsychagogy§r
Enter your inventory to view a list of all living players. You can see their tasks, whether they are going insane (via their task color), and even control what their next task will be by clicking on their head.

{icon:athletic} §lAthletic§r

announcement.goal.wathedeluxe.libertinar: Use your explosions to bring an end to the Harpy Express.
announcement.goals.wathedeluxe.libertina: Use your explosions to bring an end to the Harpy Express.
gui.watheextended.guidebook.role.desc.wa: An undertaker and a demolitionist, the Libertinari is capable of planting remote explosives within corpses. With this ability, the Libertinari's task is to demolish the Harpy Express, no matter the cost.
gui.watheextended.guidebook.role.abiliti:
{icon:grenade} §lImplant§r
Press [F] while hovering over a corpse with a grenade in your inventory to implant the grenade within the corpse. This will create a small but visible lump on its torso, alongside highlighting it as red on your screen alone.

{icon:nemesis} §lDetonate§r
Press [F] while looking in the direction of a primed corpse to activate the grenade within. This will create a small yet deadly explosion, just as a regular grenade would, alongside removing the body.

{icon:athletic} §lAthletic§r
Has infinite stamina.

{icon:instinct} §lInstinct§r
See players and §4Killer Cohorts§r through walls.
tip.wathedeluxe.libertinari.detonate_hin: Press again to detonate the corpse.
